shortDescription.am: ለፋይዳ ዲጂታል መታወቂያ ይመዝገቡ ወይም የተሳሳቱ ዝርዝሮችን ያስተካክሉ።
shortDescription.om: Qindaa'a Faydaaf galmeessaa ykn dogoggoroota sirreessaa.
shortDescription.en: Register for the Fayda digital ID or fix wrong details.

text.om: Qindaa'a jirtan (qindaa'a qe'ee ykn paaspoortii)
text.en: Any existing ID (kebele ID or passport)

text.am: የትውልድ ወረቀት ወይም የልደት ማረጋገጫ ደብዳቤ
text.om: Ragaa dhalachaa ykn mirkaneessa dhalachaa
text.en: Birth certificate or birth confirmation letter

text.am: የመኖሪያ ማስረጃ (የኤሌክትሪክ/ውሃ ቢል፣ የቤት ኪራይ መጽሐፍ ወይም የቀበሌ ደብዳቤ)
text.om: Mirkaneessa jireenyaa (billii eliktirikii/bishaanii, kitaaba kirayii manaa ykn dambii qe'ee)
text.en: Proof of address (utility bill, house rent book or kebele letter)

text.am: ዝርዝር ከሚከረምሩ፦ ስህተት ያለበት ካርድ ራሱ
text.om: Yoo dogoggora sirreessutan: kaardii dogoggora qabu isa dhiyoo
text.en: If fixing wrong details: the card that has the mistake

text.om: Lakkoofsa bilbilaa kessan (beeksisa argachuuf)
text.en: Your own phone number (to receive SMS updates)

title.en: Go to a Fayda registration center

detail.am: በወረዳዎ ወይም በከተማዎ ያለውን ማዕከል ያግኙ። አንዳንዶቹ ያለ ቀጠሮ ይቀበላሉ፤ ሌሎቹ ቀጠሮ ይጠይቃሉ።
detail.om: Wiixee naannoo keessan argadhaa. Tokkoon tokkoon qofa hin gaafatu; kan biraan koodii gaafata.
detail.en: Find the center in your woreda or city. Some accept walk-ins; others ask for an appointment.

title.en: Fill the registration form

detail.am: መረጃዎ ወደ ሥርዓቱ ያስገባል። ስምዎን እና የትውልድ ቀንዎን በጥንቃቄ ያረጋግጡ።
detail.om: Odeeffannoon kee sirreeffama. Maqaa fi guyyaa dhalachaa kee of eeggadhaa ilaalaa.
detail.en: Your details are entered into the system. Check your name and date of birth carefully.

title.om: Suuraa fi meeshaa quba kee fuudhama
title.en: Photo and fingerprints taken

detail.am: የመልክ ፎቶዎ እና የአሥርቱ ጣቶች አሻራ ይወሰዳሉ።
detail.om: Suuraa fuulaa fi meeshaa quba kudhanuu fuudhama.
detail.en: A face photo and all ten fingerprints are captured.

title.en: Your data is verified

detail.am: መረጃዎ በሥርዓቱ ይፈተሻል እና ይዛመዳል (ብዜት ለማስወገድ)። ይህ ጊዜ ሊወስድ ይችላል።
detail.om: Odeeffannoon kee ramadamee wal sima (wal dhabboosuu). Kun yeroo fudhachuu danda'a.
detail.en: Your information is checked and matched (deduplication). This may take time.

title.en: Wait for the SMS

detail.am: ካርድዎ እና ቁጥርዎ ሲዘጋጁ በስልክ ይነገርዎታል።
detail.om: Kaardii fi nambaan kee yeroo qopheessan bilbilaan beeksifamta.
detail.en: You get a text message when your Fayda number and card are ready.

title.en: Collect your Fayda card

detail.am: ደረሰኙን/መልእክቱን ይዘው ይምጡ። በፋይዳ መተግበሪያ ውስጥ ዲጂታል መታወቂያዎን መጠቀም ይችላሉ።
detail.om: Risiitii/ergaa fidaa. Qindaa'a digitaalaa appii Faydaa keessatti fayyadamuu dandeessu.
detail.en: Bring the SMS/receipt. You can also use your digital ID in the Fayda app.

note.am: በኦፊሴላዊ መረጃ መሠረት ምዝገባው በነፃ ነው።
note.om: Odeeffannoo sirreeffamaa akka exeertaan galmeessan bilisaa dha.
note.en: Registration itself is free according to official information.

estimatedTime.am: በማዕከሉ 30–60 ደቂቃ፤ ካርዱ በአንድ–ሁለት ሳምንት ይዘጋጃል (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Wiixeetti daqiiqaa 30–60; kaardii torban 1–2 booda qophaa'a (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: 30–60 minutes at the center; card ready in about 1–2 weeks (confirm)

text.am: ስምዎ ከትውልድ ወረቀትዎ ጋር በፊደል በትክክል ይዛመድ
text.om: Maqaan kee ragaa dhalachaa kee waliin qubee-qubee wal simu
text.en: Your name must exactly match your birth certificate

text.am: የእያንዳንዱን ሰነድ ዋናውን እና ኮፒውን ያመጡ
text.om: Docsiin hundaa asii fi copy isaa fidaa
text.en: Bring both the original and a photocopy of each document

text.am: የቤተሰብ ሰው ሳይሆን የራስዎን ስልክ ቁጥር ይጠቀሙ፤ መልእክቱ እርስዎን እንዲደርስ
text.om: Lakkoofsa kan nama biraatiin osoo hin taane kan kessan fayyadamaa
text.en: Use your own phone number, not a relative's, so the SMS reaches you

text.am: የትውልድ ቀንዎ ከትውልድ ወረቀትዎ ጋር ይዛመድ፤ የሚወዱት ቀን አይጻፍም
text.om: Guyyaan dhalachaa kee kan ragaa irratti akka ta'e godhaa
text.en: Your date of birth must match your birth certificate, not the date you prefer

shortDescription.am: አዲስ የቀበሌ መታወቂያ ማግኘት፣ መደስተካከል ወይም መተካት።
shortDescription.om: Qindaa'a qe'ee haaraa argachuu, fooyyessuu ykn bakka buusuu.
shortDescription.en: Get a new kebele ID, renew it, or replace a lost one.

text.am: የድሮ መታወቂያ፣ የትውልድ ወረቀት ወይም ሌላ ማንነት ማስረጃ
text.om: Qindaa'a duraanffaa, ragaa dhalachaa ykn mirkaneessa addaa
text.en: Old ID, birth certificate or other identity proof

text.om: Suuraa haaraa tokko (hamma paaspoortii)
text.en: One recent passport-size photo

text.am: በቀበሌው መኖርዎን የሚያሳይ ማስረጃ (የቤት ኪራይ መጽሐፍ፣ የቤት ባለቤት ደብዳቤ)
text.om: Mirkaneessa naannoo qe'ee kessaa jiraachuu kee (kitaaba kirayii manaa, dambii abbaa manaa)
text.en: Proof you live in the kebele (house rent book, letter from the house owner)

text.om: Nama naannoo qe'ee jiru raguu (waajjiratti gaafadhaa)
text.en: A witness who lives in the kebele (ask your office)

title.en: Go to your kebele office

detail.am: በሚኖሩበት ቀበሌ ብቻ ነው የሚሠራው። ጠዋት መሄድ ያነሱ ሰው ሊያገኙ።
detail.om: Qe'ee kee qofaatti ni hojjeta. Ganama deemuu danda'ama namni xiqqaan jira.
detail.en: It only works for the kebele you live in. Going early means fewer people.

title.en: The kebele guide verifies your residence

detail.am: ጓዱ፣ በቀበሌው እንደሚኖሩ በቀጥታ ያረጋግጣል።
detail.om: Guddinni akka naannoo san jirtan mirkaneessa.
detail.en: The kebele guide confirms that you really live there.

title.en: Fill the form and pay the fee

detail.am: ክፍያውን በየትምህርት ቤት ማስረጃ ወይም በቢሮው ፋይናንስ ይክፈሉ። ደረሰኙን ይያዙ።
detail.om: Kaffaltii waajjira herregaa keessatti kaffalaa. Risiitii qabadhaa.
detail.en: Pay at the office finance desk and keep the receipt.

title.en: Photo attached

detail.am: አንዳንድ ቢሮዎች ቦታው ላይ ያረፍሱ፤ ሌሎቹ የቀደመ ፎቶ ይጠይቃሉ።
detail.om: Waajjironni tokko tokko achitti suuraa fuudhu; kan biraan suuraa duraan qopheessame gaafatu.
detail.en: Some offices take the photo there; others ask you to bring one.

title.en: Collect your ID

detail.am: በተለምዶ ከጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ይዘጋጃል። ደረሰኙን ይዘው ይምጡ።
detail.om: Akka tulluu guyyoota booda qophaa'a. Risiitii fiduu daggeessaa.
detail.en: Usually ready after a few days. Bring your receipt.

estimatedTime.am: በቢሮው 20–40 ደቂቃ፤ መታወቂያው በ2–5 ቀናት (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Waajjiratti daqiiqaa 20–40; qindaa'an guyyoota 2–5 booda (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: 20–40 minutes at the office; ID ready in 2–5 days (confirm)

text.am: በቤት ኪራይ መጽሐፍዎ ላይ ያለው ስም ከመታወቂያዎ ጋር ይዛመድ
text.om: Maqaan kitaaba kirayii irratti jiru qindaa'a kee waliin wal simu
text.en: The name on your house rent book must match your ID

text.am: የድሮ ወይም የተሸፈነ ፎቶ አይቀበልም፤ የቅርብ ጊዜ ፎቶ ይውሰዱ
text.om: Suuraa duraanffaa hin fudhatamu; suuraa haaraa fuudhaa
text.en: Old or covered photos are refused — take a recent one

text.am: ሰኞ እና የወር መጨረሻ ብዙ ሰው አለ፤ የሚቻልበትን ቀን ይምረጡ
text.om: Wiixataa fi xumura ji'aa namni baay'ee jira; guyyaa filadhaa
text.en: Mondays and month-end are crowded — pick a calmer day

shortDescription.am: ለአዲስ ልጅ ወይም ለዘግይቶ ምዝገባ የትውልድ ወረቀት ያግኙ።
shortDescription.om: Da'umsa haaraa ykn galmee dheeraa ragaa dhalachaa argadhaa.
shortDescription.en: Get a birth certificate for a newborn or through late registration.

text.om: Beekssa dhalachaa hospitaalaa/gargaarsa fayyaa irraa
text.en: Birth notification from the hospital, health center or midwife

text.om: Qindaa'a haadhaa ykn abbaa
text.en: ID of the mother or father

text.om: Ragaa gaa'elaa warraabootaa (yoo gaafatame)
text.en: Parents' marriage certificate (when asked)

text.am: ለዘግይቶ ምዝገባ፦ የመዘግየቱን ምክንያት የሚገልጽ የቀበሌ/ወረዳ ደብዳቤ
text.om: Galmee dheeraaf: dambii qe'ee/woredaa maqaa sababa hir'atu ibsu
text.en: For late registration: a kebele/woreda letter explaining the delay (ask office)

title.en: Get the birth notification

detail.am: ከትውልድ ቦታው (ሆስፒታል፣ ጤና ማዕከል) በቀጥታ ይውሰዱ። በቤት ከተወለደ ወደ ጤና ማዕከል ይሂዱ።
detail.om: Bakka dhalachaa irraa fudhaa. Manaa dhalate manneen fayyaa deemii.
detail.en: Collect it from the place of birth. For a home birth, go to the health center.

title.en: Go to the civil registration office

detail.am: በወረዳዎ ወይም በከተማዎ አቅራቢያ ይገኛል።
detail.om: Naannoo woredaa ykn magaalaa keessatti argama.
detail.en: It is usually in your woreda or city administration.

title.en: Fill the form

detail.am: የልጁ ስም፣ የወላጆች መረጃ እና የትውልድ ቀን ይጻፋል።
detail.om: Maqaa da'umsaa, odeeffannoo warraabootaa fi guyyaa dhalachaa galmeefama.
detail.en: The child's name, parents' details and birth date are recorded.

title.en: Receive the certificate

detail.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በዚያው ቀን ይሰጣል። ተጨማሪ ኮፒ ወስደው ያስቀምጡ።
detail.om: Baay'een guyyaa kanaatti ni kennamu. Copy dabalataa fuudhaa olkaa'aa.
detail.en: Often issued the same day. Take extra copies and keep them safe.

estimatedTime.am: በቢሮው 20–30 ደቂቃ፤ ብዙ ጊ᜕ በዚያው ቀን ይሰጣል
estimatedTime.om: Waajjiratti daqiiqaa 20–30; baay'ee guyyaa kanaatti kennamu
estimatedTime.en: 20–30 minutes at the office; often issued the same day

text.am: በ90 ቀናት ውስጥ ይመዝገቡ፤ ከዘገዩ ተጨማሪ ሰነዶች ሊጠየቁ ይችላሉ
text.om: Guyyoota 90 keessaa galmeessaa; yoo dheeratten docsii dabalataa gaafatamuu danda'a
text.en: Register within 90 days — later means extra documents

text.am: የልጁን ስም ፊደል በትክክል ያረጋግጡ — በወረቀቱ ላይ ከተጻፈ ስህተት ማስተካከያ ችግር ይፈጥራል
text.om: Maqaa da'umsaa qubee isaa ilaalaa; dogoggoran ragaa irratti rakkoo uuma
text.en: Check the child's name spelling — mistakes on the certificate cause problems later

text.am: የማሳወቂያውን ዋናውን ይዘው ይምጡ፤ ኮፒ ብቻ አይቀበልም
text.om: Beekssa dhalachaa haaraa fidaa; copy qofa hin fudhatamu
text.en: Bring the original notification; a photocopy alone is refused

shortDescription.am: ጋብቻዎን በሲቪል ምዝገባ ያረጋግጡ እና ወረቀት ያግኙ።
shortDescription.om: Gaa'ela keessan galmee siviilii keessatti galmeessinee ragaa argadhaa.
shortDescription.en: Register your marriage at civil registration and get the certificate.

text.om: Qindaa'a lamaanu walitti qabamee
text.en: ID of both partners

text.om: Qindaa'a ragootaa lamaan
text.en: IDs of two witnesses

text.om: Gaa'ela duraatiif: ragaa hiikkaa
text.en: If previously married: divorce certificate

title.am: ሁለቱም ትዕግስተኞች ወደ ሲቪል ምዝገባ ይሂዱ
title.en: Both partners go to civil registration

detail.am: ሁለቱም መኖር ይጠበቃል።
detail.om: Lamaanu akka jiraatan barbaachisa.
detail.en: Both must be present in person.

title.am: ቅጾቹን ከምስክሮች ጋር ይሙሉ እና ይፈርሙ
title.om: Foomii ragootaa waliin guutaa fi mallatteessaa
title.en: Fill and sign the forms with your witnesses
The registrar reviews everything
Collect the marriage certificate

detail.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በተወሰነ ቀን ወይም በቀጠሮ ይሰጣል።
detail.om: Baay'een guyyaa murtaa'e ykn koodiin kennama.
detail.en: Usually given on a set day or by appointment.

estimatedTime.am: በቢሮው ከ1 ሰዓት ገደማ፤ ወረቀቱ በ2–7 ቀናት (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Waajjiratti sa'aatii 1 dhiyoo; ragaan guyyoota 2–7 booda (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: About 1 hour at the office; certificate in 2–7 days (confirm)

text.om: Tokko yoo hin jiraatin galmee hin hojjetu
text.en: Registration fails if one partner is absent

text.om: Ragoonni qindaa'a dhabee deebi'uu dirqama
text.en: Witnesses without their IDs will be sent back

text.am: ከቀድሞ ጋብቻ ያለ የፍቺ ወረቀት አዲስ ጋብቻ አይመዘገብም
text.om: Ragaa hiikkaa malee gaa'ela haaraan hin galmeeffamu
text.en: A new marriage cannot be registered without a divorce certificate from the previous one

shortDescription.am: አዲስ ፓስፖርት ይውሰዱ፣ ያድሱ ወይም የጠፋውን ይተኩ።
shortDescription.om: Paaspoortii haaraa fuudhi, fooyyessi ykn kan dhabee bakka buusi.
